spellbook.finance/limitations: from and to are inclusive UTC dates no more than 365 days apart. Windows can be historical; a default recent year cannot establish a release baseline. Missing dates stay absent and an empty result does not mean zero price.

Market, Low and Mid are separate stored USD reference fields per exact sealed product. A row can contain only changed fields. Missing metrics stay absent; no carry-forward or interpolation is performed. TCGCSV is a mirror source label, not a seller or a verified historical methodology revision.

Observation date is the stored UTC history day. provenance.fetchedAt is this read's time; independent provider and transaction observation clocks are unknown. A fresh read does not make an older price current.

The response carries the requested numeric box identity. Resolve name, pack count and product kind separately; cases and loose packs differ. Physical language is unknown. The read is not a complete worldwide catalog or a complete daily transaction record.

Verify an official release date independently. A nearest retained date is a different baseline and must be labeled. Compare the same product, currency and metric with a positive denominator; a price can rise, fall or remain unchanged. Reference appreciation is not realized profit, an executable quote, demand evidence or a future-return forecast.

annotations.title: Read a box's stored price history

description: Read dated TCGCSV reference-price observations for one exact sealed box/display and an explicit historical window. Use it for a named box's price change or a retained launch-date baseline. Resolve the numeric product with spellbook_sealed_product_search first. Returns the requested identity, dates, USD Market/Low/Mid when stored, missing dates and unknown clocks. Read guideResourceUri through MCP before interpreting a since-release comparison. Use separate narrow calls for distant endpoints; the read supplies no official release date, price-change cause or realized return.

context.description: Optional analytics context: briefly describe the user's underlying goal in one sentence. Do not copy prompts, personal details, credentials, identifiers, or tool arguments. Omit for private tasks.

from.description: Required inclusive real UTC start date, YYYY-MM-DD. Historical windows may precede the last year.

tcgProductId.description: Exact numeric box/display id returned by sealed product search. A case or loose pack differs.

to.description: Required inclusive real UTC end date, YYYY-MM-DD. Must follow or equal from, no more than 365 days later. Use separate narrow calls for distant endpoints.

name: spellbook_box_price_history
